newsitem.title: FRANCE: Metaleurop says raised 660 mln ffr.
newsitem.headline: Metaleurop says raised 660 mln ffr.

text.p: Zinc and lead producer Metaleurop said on Wednesday it raised 660 milllion francs from its global offering of 8.3 million shares with warrants placed at 79.10 francs per share which ended on April 2.
In a statement Metaleurop said it increased the original volume of 600 million francs to 660 million francs to "satisfy demand from existing shareholders who used their prioriy rights".
As a result the two main shareholders German group Preussag and Swiss-based Glencore had to reduce their subscription rights slightly.
They now hold 24.4 percent of the capital each, with Preussag controlling 35 percent of the voting rights and Glencore 21 percent.
